column2: That [GetRootFromInsult] [From.GetBestName] has declared war on me to free the captives I rightfully hold! If [From.GetSheHe] wants a war over them, I have every right to see that [From.GetSheHe] gets nothing back but their heads...
This war must end. Offer to send their people back.
I must make an example. Execute [warcb_chosen_captive.GetFirstName].
Drag [warcb_chosen_captive.GetFirstName] to the altar. The gods are thirsty.
How dare they? Execute ALL the captives!
Give them all to the gods!
We shall meet on the battlefield.
[From.GetBestName] has sent an envoy with an offer: if we end this war, [From.GetSheHe] will free all the captives and let them travel safely to our court!
Excellent! We accept.
Ha! I am in this for the loot and plunder. The war goes on!
[From.GetBestName] has accepted our offer to free the captives. The war is over!
It is for the best.
[From.GetBestName] had the gall to refuse our offer. The lives of the captives mean nothing to [From.GetHerHim]: the war was only ever about plunder!
The war goes on.
Let us see if they mean little to [From.GetHerHim] when they are all dead!
Then let their blood feed the gods!
Disaster! In answer to our declaration of war, that [GetRootFromInsult] [From.GetBestName] has beheaded [warcb_chosen_captive.GetFirstName]! We should have seen this coming...

Disaster! In answer to our declaration of war, that [GetRootFromInsult] [From.GetBestName] has dragged [warcb_chosen_captive.GetFirstName] to the altar and spilled [warcb_chosen_captive.GetHerHis] blood for [From.Religion.GetHighGodName]! We should have seen this coming...
Oh, now it is personal!
In answer to our declaration of war, that [GetRootFromInsult] [From.GetBestName] has had every one of the captives beheaded! We should have seen this coming...

In answer to our declaration of war, that [GetRootFromInsult] [From.GetBestName] has given every one of the captives to [From.Religion.GetHighGodName] in a night of screams and blood! We should have seen this coming...
This is a war of vengeance now!

My heart burns when I hear of the [Root.Religion.GetName] faithful oppressed in the realm of [liberate_target.GetBestName]. [Root.Religion.GetHighGodName] meant every true believer to live free, and if [Root.Religion.GetHighGodName] is busy with divine things, perhaps I should do the work myself?
I must free my [Root.Religion.GetName] brethren!
I have better things to do...
Our tributary [From.PrimaryTitle.GetName] has stopped paying tribute! [From.GetTitledFirstName] calls us weak and says we cannot defend [From.GetHerHis] realm. What nonsense!
Perhaps it is time to bring [From.GetHerHim] back in line...

[tribute_war_suzerain.GetTitledFirstName] wants to squeeze a flow of gold out of the lands of [Root.PrimaryTitle.GetName], and is willing to send [tribute_war_suzerain.GetHerHis] soldiers to die for it. But am I as willing to send mine? I could surrender now, before my soldiers are slaughtered, their families left to die and the villages burnt to the ground... or we fight to protect our land and drive back these [tribute_war_suzerain.Culture.GetName] invaders!
I shall end this before the blood of my people soaks the land.
We must protect what is ours! We fight!

To [Root.GetTitledFirstName],

Let us end this conflict without bloodshed. I agree to your demands: the lands of [From.PrimaryTitle.GetName] will pay you tribute. All I ask is that you spare my people and send your soldiers home.

Signed,
[From.GetTitledName]
A wise decision! I accept [From.GetHerHis] offer.
Look at the coward beg! There will be no peace for [From.GetHerHim] so easily.

To [Root.GetTitledFirstName],

You have chosen wisely. I accept your offer and will send my soldiers home in exchange for tribute from your lands.

Signed,
[From.GetTitledName]
We are safe... for now...

To [Root.GetTitledFirstName],

Yours is the offer of a coward. Ready your soldiers to meet mine in battle, as a true warrior would.

Signed,
[From.GetTitledName]
I had a feeling it would come to this.
